signal: 365 Retail Markets completed its acquisition of Cantaloupe and launched VisionLink for modular Vision Smart Stores

email.body1:
Edward, saw 365 closed the Cantaloupe acquisition and launched VisionLink for the modular Vision Smart Stores.

Absorbing a major acquisition usually means more dining and operator accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp on the combined lineup, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for 365's dining motion off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Edward, quick follow-up for 365's dining team.

Post-acquisition, the combined pipeline target usually climbs faster than you can hire and ramp reps across the new product mix. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your dining team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Edward, last bit of proof for 365.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your dining team's reply rate likely compares to other unattended-retail GTM teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Edward, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling dining pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the Cantaloupe integration settles, no problem at all. A merger is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your dining sales motion? I'll tailor it to 365 either way.
